purpose: A floating Liquid Glass tab bar for compact width (at regular width use the system sidebar). Its lens stretches to a new tab, follows a drag across the bar and settles on the nearest tab, and takes an optional tint. While content scrolls down it shrinks to its icons: every tab stays, the lens stays on the selected one, the bar keeps its place.
accessibility: The bar carries the tab-bar trait; each tab is a VoiceOver button with its title and the selected trait, at least 48 pt. Collapsed, every tab stays reachable: a tap on the selected one expands the bar, a tap on another selects it. Labels grow to XXXL; beyond that the Large Content Viewer shows the tab. Reduce Motion drops the springs and the stretch; Reduce Transparency puts a solid ground under the bar. Selection haptic. Requires iOS 26.
name: LivingTabBar
